title: Who grew and smoked cannabis on Ternate in 1676?
short: The Dutch ordered the destruction of a plant they called gingie. Who cultivated it, and what happened after the ban?
matters: The order records people growing the plant and smoking it with tobacco on Ternate. It offers a rare glimpse of local drug use through a hostile colonial source.
stuck: The February council decision and its proclamation describe a policy. They do not establish who owned the gardens, how many plants were destroyed or whether the order was enforced.
solved: A contemporary source should connect named growers, places or authorities with cultivation, enforcement or continued use after the proclamation.
approach: Search later Ternate council records and correspondence for spelling variants of gingie, for the named officials in the decision, and for follow-up orders.
